item.title: Expert Says 99% of People May Never Own 1 XRP: Here’s Why
item.description: An XRP community pundit has suggested that 99% of the global population may never be able to own up to 1 full XRP token. Notably, XRP continues to face sharp market swings, yet some community figures see the current phase as a chance to buy at lower prices.Visit Website

item.title: Japanese Analyst Says XRP Holders Should Pay Close Attention to This Update from Japan
item.description: Japanese financial commentator Yuto Kanzaki has highlighted a possible major turning point for Ripple and XRP. In a tweet, he mentioned that Japan and South Korea are quietly discussing joint blockchain projects.Visit Website

item.title: Cardano Founder Denies Dumping ADA at $3 Amid 88% Price Decline
item.description: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson has pushed back against claims that he sold his ADA holdings near the token’s all-time high. Like many crypto executives, Hoskinson took to X to wish his followers a Merry Christmas.Visit Website

item.title: Crypto Educator Says People Claiming XRP Can’t Go Past $10 Haven’t Done Their Research
item.description: The discussions around XRP double-digit price are heating up again, as crypto educator Jesse, founder of Apex Crypto Academy, weighs in. He argues that dismissing XRP’s ability to move beyond $10 ignores how global financial infrastructure actually works.Visit Website

item.title: Mike Novogratz Says Strong Communities Keep XRP and Cardano Relevant
item.description: Galaxy Digital founder and CEO Mike Novogratz has recently drawn attention to the resilience of the XRP and Cardano communities. Speaking on a recent podcast, Novogratz emphasized that sustained community engagement has emerged as a critical factor in determining long-term survival in the cryptocurrency market.Visit Website

item.title: Jake Claver Losing XRP to $100 Bet as 2025 Closes in 5 Days
item.description: XRP community figure Jake Claver may be on the verge of losing his "XRP to $100" bet as the year 2025 closes in five days. Ambitious price forecasts have always circulated within the XRP community, but few have drawn as much attention as the call made by Jake Claver, CEO of Digital Ascension Group.Visit Website

item.title: Russia–U.S. Negotiations Take Unexpected Turn with Bitcoin Mining Idea
item.description: Claims of potential Bitcoin mining at Europe’s largest nuclear power plant have added an unexpected dimension to already complex Russia–Ukraine negotiations. Russian President Vladimir Putin recently told business leaders that the United States has expressed interest in Bitcoin mining at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant.Visit Website

item.title: Cardano Founder Says XRP and Midnight Are “100x Beyond” Legacy Finance
item.description: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson argues that the legacy finance–backed Canton Network cannot match the performance of XRP and Midnight in the real-world asset (RWA) sector. In recent months, several traditional financial institutions, including State Street and BNY Mellon, have partnered on the Canton Network to advance RWA tokenization.Visit Website

item.title: Russia’s Largest Bank Sberbank Explores Bitcoin-Backed Loans in Rubles
item.description: Russia’s largest lender, Sberbank, is considering a major move into Bitcoin and crypto-backed lending. According to Russia's state-owned news agency Tass, Sberbank is exploring the issuance of loans in rubles secured by crypto holdings.Visit Website

item.title: Pundit Says You’re Delusional if You Think XRP Price Doesn’t Follow BTC
item.description: A market pundit has called attention to a trend involving XRP and Bitcoin's price correlation, noting that both assets tend to move in lockstep. This recent commentary came from King Valex, an XRP community commentator, on the back of the market's downward trend.Visit Website
